method_units.macro_method_name: Multi-Scale Context Modeling and Data Augmentation and Context Diversification
method_units.micro_method_name: novel recurrent unit, cross-modal long short-term memory (CM-LSTM), by mimicking the human cognitive process of localizing temporal moments
method_units.method_core_mechanism: To address these shortcomings, we introduce a novel recurrent unit, cross-modal long short-term memory (CM-LSTM), by mimicking the human cognitive process of localizing temporal moments that focuses on the part of a video segment related to the part of a query, and accumulates the contextual information across the entire video recurrently.

evidence.quote: To address these shortcomings, we introduce a novel recurrent unit, cross-modal long short-term memory (CM-LSTM), by mimicking the human cognitive process of localizing temporal moments that focuses on the part of a video segment related to the part of a query, and accumulates the contextual information across the entire video recurrently.

method_units.macro_method_name: Boundary-Aware Representation and Regression and Proposal Generation and Candidate Decoding
method_units.method_core_mechanism: To obtain more precise boundaries, we propose a two-stream attentive cross-modal interaction network (TACI) that generates two 2D proposal maps obtained globally from the integrated contextual features, which are generated by using CM-LSTM, and locally from boundary score sequences and then combines them into a final 2D map in an end-to-end manner.

evidence.quote: To obtain more precise boundaries, we propose a two-stream attentive cross-modal interaction network (TACI) that generates two 2D proposal maps obtained globally from the integrated contextual features, which are generated by using CM-LSTM, and locally from boundary score sequences and then combines them into a final 2D map in an end-to-end manner.
